name: Sample Size
subtitle: The outside edit. Your taste, discovered.
localizedDescription: Black/silver clothing discovery and design workspace. Browse fresh products sourced from official Jaded London, Affliction and Ed Hardy stores, with a daily refreshed feed, personal and brand taste lanes, saved collections, and exact-version design reviews. Your original references stay in a separate archive. Product photos require internet; verify stock, price and sizing at the store. Feedback stays on your phone until exported. Unsigned: sign and install with your own Feather certificate. Requires iOS16.4 or later.
